result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.trav_reverse_edge()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Traverse to reverse edges. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L6638-L6701){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.trav_reverse_edge(add_to_selection=False) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} From the currently selected edges, finds the reverse edges. For each selected edge `A->B`, looks for the corresponding edge `B->A`. Only works with directed graphs. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [add_to_selection]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, adds reverse edges to the current selection. If `False`, replaces the selection with reverse edges only. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#54489f72 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="A") # Reverse edge ) # Select A->B edge a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") b_id = graph.get_id_from_label("B") graph.select_edges_by_node([a_id, b_id]) # Traverse to reverse edge (B->A) graph.trav_reverse_edge() edges = graph.get_selected_edge_ids() # Now selects only the B->A edge ``` ::: Add reverse edges to selection: ::: {#632cde56 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="A") ) edge_ids = list(graph.get_edge_ids()) # Select both an edge and its reverse (graph .select_edges_by_id([edge_ids[0]]) .trav_reverse_edge(add_to_selection=True) ) # Selection now includes both A->B and B->A ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 2 Directed : True Density : 1.00 Average degree (min, max) : 2.00 (2, 2) Strongly connected : True Weakly connected : True Number of strongly connected components : 1 Number of weakly connected components : 1 ``` ::: :::
